title: File:Frances (Appleton) Longfellow to Susan (Benjamin) Stackpole, 13 April 1835 (c4cf1f46-5d02-4bc6-8057-f10564b509f7).jpg
desc:
Manuscript letter
Archives Number: 1011/002.001-005#002
Boston. April 13th 1835.   
Your letter of the 5th came duly to hand (as the Merchants say) & truly grateful am I for 
it, my dearest.  It finds me in the novel & independent character of
“maitresse de la maison”, Mary’s departure, on Thursday
